purpose: Echo-9 humanoid Transformers-inspired photoreal concept references, not actual model renders

images.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept, cinematic photorealism. Completely redesign the robot in the reference as ECHO-9, an original humanoid alien robot in the visual style of the live-action Transformers films. The user explicitly rejects the box-built Gundam/model-kit anatomy of the reference. Change the fundamental shape language and anatomy, not merely surface weathering. Reference is ONLY for loose ivory/navy/cyan color identity; DO NOT preserve its armor geometry, head, antennae, shoulder blocks, boot shapes, rib cages, or proportions. New silhouette: tall athletic HUMAN anatomical proportions, approximately eight heads tall; organically sculpted deltoids with curved overlapping armor scales, recognizable clavicles and pectorals, narrow flexible waist, segmented abdominal muscles, curved pelvis, long powerful tapered thighs, natural knees, sculpted calves, normal proportioned feet with articulated toes, humanlike five-finger hands. Body has subtle asymmetrical overlapping vehicle-like curved sheet-metal fragments interwoven with extraordinarily intricate titanium mechanical tendons and metallic muscle-fiber bundles; layered dense Transformers engineering fits INSIDE a readable human anatomy. Humanlike alien face made of intricate silver mechanical facial plates with sculpted cheekbones, brow, articulated jaw and subtle mouth; expressive luminous cyan eyes, no human skin. Swept integrated helmet contours, NO V-fin horns or antennas. Curved ivory and deep midnight-navy panels with sparse muted red details over dark titanium; naturally curved flowing surfaces, muscular S-curves, elegant complex mechanical anatomy. No boxes, rectangular shoulder pads, flat slabs, toy parts, cubes, giant boots, barrels as elbows, superhero bodysuit, smooth plastic mannequin, or cartoon appearance. It must look like a living sentient mechanical humanoid, imposing yet agile, with photographic metal, subtly worn ceramic clearcoat, real fine scratches and natural reflections. Portrait 2:3 full-body cinematic photograph, head-to-toe visible with margins, relaxed contrapposto front three-quarter pose, hands visible, no handheld weapon. Inside a vast softly lit industrial spaceship hangar, cool soft overhead light and restrained warm side light; entire silhouette and all mechanical details clearly visible, no excessive dark shadows, shallow background depth of field, 50mm lens. Extraordinary live-action blockbuster VFX realism. One robot only, no text or watermark.

No grid overlays, no dimensions, no logos or watermark.
